# Pull Request Guidelines

## Before Submitting

⚠️ **To merge this PR, you need approval from `founding5067` (the maintainer).**

### Steps to Request Merging
1. Tag the maintainer in the PR discussion (e.g., "@founding5067" on GitHub)
2. Wait for review and approval
3. Once approved, I will merge your PR on your behalf

### PR Requirements
- [ ] Code follows Swift conventions
- [ ] Tests are passing (`swift test`)
- [ ] No breaking changes (or breaking changes are clearly documented)
- [ ] Code is properly formatted

---

**Note:** This repository is public for educational/reference purposes. Direct merges are restricted to maintainers.
